tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('daily_cost_2.csv')
g = df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName'])['BilledCost']
# z-score per group using median/MAD robust
def robust_z(x):
    med = x.median()
    mad = (x-med).abs().median()
    return 0.6745*(x-med)/mad
df['z'] = df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName'])['BilledCost'].transform(robust_z)
top = df.reindex(df['z'].abs().sort_values(ascending=False).index).head(15)
print(top[['ChargePeriodStart','SubAccountName','ServiceName','BilledCost','z']])
